zh: next-token cross-entropy 在真实 prefix 上最大化训练数据似然
teacher forcing 提供逐位置并行监督，但训练与闭环 rollout 的 prefix 分布不同
平均 loss/perplexity 不能替代关键 Agent 决策和长轨迹成功率
结构化 observation 与 verifier 可以帮助错误轨迹恢复
en: Next-token cross-entropy maximizes training-data likelihood on ground-truth prefixes
Teacher forcing provides parallel per-position supervision while training and closed-loop rollout prefixes follow different distributions
Average loss or perplexity cannot replace evaluation of critical agent decisions and long-horizon success
Structured observations and verifiers can help an erroneous trajectory recover

next.zh: 进入优化与 scaling：learning rate、batch、AdamW、数据混合与 compute budget 怎样把局部梯度变成模型能力，以及 scaling law 的预测边界。
next.en: Move into optimization and scaling: how learning rates, batches, AdamW, data mixtures, and compute budgets turn local gradients into model capability, and where scaling-law predictions stop.
